summary.analysis: Average the three noise repeats within each complete test history. Bootstrap complete histories for paired mean differences. Intervals are exploratory, pointwise 95% intervals, conditional on this material and history distribution.
summary.scope: Fixed synthetic material, geometry and forward model. No controller comparison, parameter mismatch or neural training. All physical and optimization failures are retained. No selection by future effects.
